title: THE WORLD ON FRIDAY 20 NOVEMBER 2026
subtitle: KYIV BRIDGES HIT - WALL STREET IN CORRECTION - COP31 OVERRUNS - UK-EU SUMMIT

hero.title: RUSSIAN STRIKES HIT KYIV BRIDGES
hero.text: Overnight drones and missiles struck three bridges in Kyiv and killed 8 people there, the mayor said. A strike on Lviv rail station killed 2 and 28 were hurt across nine regions. Poland said Russia breached its airspace.

tiles.title: WALL ST ENTERS CORRECTION
tiles.text: S&P 500 fell 3.7%, Nasdaq 5.3%; Nvidia lost 14% on a report of SEC scrutiny.

tiles.title: COP31 MISSES DEADLINE
tiles.text: Antalya talks run past Friday's close, split over a draft with no fossil fuel line.

tiles.title: UK-EU SUMMIT IN BRUSSELS
tiles.text: Youth visa scheme of up to 100,000 a year on the table; tuition row unresolved.

tiles.title: POLAND REPORTS INCURSION
tiles.text: Two missiles and a drone entered Polish airspace during the Russian strikes.

tiles.title: IRAQ TROOPS ENTER JURF
tiles.text: Forces deploy into a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold under a compromise deal.

tiles.title: HODEIDAH PORT STRUCK
tiles.text: Saudi-led coalition hits Yemen port; Houthis threaten Saudi Red Sea ports.

tiles.title: MYANMAR REJECTS ICJ RULING
tiles.text: Government calls the 9-6 genocide finding unfair; rights groups seek sanctions.

tiles.title: CYCLONE AKVAN LANDS
tiles.text: Storm makes landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha, India, with heavy rain.

tiles.title: ASIA SHARES SLUMP
tiles.text: Taiwan's TAIEX fell 6.2%, Kospi 5.2% and the Nikkei 5.1%.

tiles.title: HAITI GANG RAID
tiles.text: Police say 34 suspected gang members were killed in Port-au-Prince.

tiles.title: SYDNEY TERROR CHARGE
tiles.text: Man charged after police raids across 10 suburbs of Sydney.

tiles.title: S KOREA CHOLERA CASE
tiles.text: First confirmed case of cholera in the country in about a decade.
